# **Event Management API Documentation**

_REST API reference covering authentication, users, events, categories, enrolments, results, and weather._

| Method | Route | Description | Role Required | Request Body | Expected Response |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | /api/auth/register | Registers a new user (Participant or Organiser). | None (Public) | { firstName, lastName, email, password, role } | 201 Created: { userId, email, role }400 Bad Request: Validation errors (e.g., duplicate email) |
| POST | /api/auth/login | Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token. | None (Public) | { email, password } | 200 OK: { token, userId, role, firstName }401 Unauthorized: Invalid credentials |
| GET | /api/users/me | Gets the profile of the currently authenticated user. | Any (Logged In) | None | 200 OK: { userId, firstName, lastName, email, role, dateRegistered }401 Unauthorized: Not logged in |
| PUT | /api/users/me | Updates the profile of the currently authenticated user. | Any (Logged In) | { firstName, lastName, email } | 200 OK: { userId, firstName, lastName, email }400 Bad Request: Validation errors |
| GET | /api/events | Gets a list of all events, with optional filtering (status, date range). | None (Public) | None (query params: status, startDate, endDate) | 200 OK: [ { eventId, name, date, location, status, organiserName } ] |
| GET | /api/events/{id} | Gets detailed information for a single event. | None (Public) | None | 200 OK: Full event details with categories404 Not Found: Event does not exist |
| POST | /api/events | Creates a new event. | Organiser | { name, description, date, location, maxParticipants, categories: [ { name, description, entryFee, startTime, maxCapacity } ] } | 201 Created: { eventId, name, date, status }400 Bad Request: Validation errors |
| PUT | /api/events/{id} | Updates an existing event. | Organiser (Owner) | { name, description, date, location, maxParticipants, status } | 200 OK: Updated event object403 Forbidden: User is not the organiser404 Not Found: Event does not exist |
| DELETE | /api/events/{id} | Deletes an event (and its associated categories/enrolments). | Organiser (Owner) | None | 204 No Content: Successfully deleted403 Forbidden: User is not the organiser |
| POST | /api/events/{id}/categories | Adds a new category to an existing event. | Organiser (Owner) | { name, description, entryFee, startTime, maxCapacity } | 201 Created: { categoryId, name, entryFee }404 Not Found: Event does not exist |
| GET | /api/events/{eventId}/categories/{categoryId} | Gets details for a specific category within an event. | None (Public) | None | 200 OK: Category details with current enrolment count404 Not Found: Event or Category not found |
| POST | /api/enrolments | Enrols a participant in a specific category for an event. | Participant | { eventId, categoryId } | 201 Created: { enrolmentId, status, bibNumber }400 Bad Request: Category full, already enrolled, etc.404 Not Found: Event or Category not found |
| GET | /api/enrolments/me | Gets all enrolments for the currently logged-in participant. | Participant | None | 200 OK: [ { enrolmentId, eventName, categoryName, status, enrolmentDate } ] |
| DELETE | /api/enrolments/{id} | Cancels an enrolment. | Participant (Owner) | None | 204 No Content: Successfully cancelled403 Forbidden: User is not the participant who enrolled404 Not Found: Enrolment not found |
| GET | /api/events/{eventId}/results | Gets all results for a specific event. | Any (Logged In) | None | 200 OK: [ { participantName, categoryName, finishTime, position, status } ]404 Not Found: Event not found |
| POST | /api/events/{eventId}/results | Records or updates results for participants in an event. | Organiser (Owner) | [ { participantId, categoryId, finishTime, position, status } ] | 201 Created: { count } results processed400 Bad Request: Validation errors404 Not Found: Event or Participant not found |
| GET | /api/results/me | Gets all results for the currently logged-in participant. | Participant | None | 200 OK: [ { eventName, categoryName, finishTime, position, date } ] |
| GET | /api/events/{eventId}/weather | Gets the latest weather forecast for an event's location. | None (Public) | None | Not yet specified |

CREATE DATABASE RaceDay;

\-- Users Table (Holds both Organisers and Participants)

CREATE TABLE Users (

UserId INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

FirstName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

LastName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

Email NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

PasswordHash NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

Role NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (Role IN ('Organiser', 'Participant')),

DateRegistered DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

IsActive BIT DEFAULT 1

);

\-- Events Table

CREATE TABLE Events (

EventId INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

OrganiserId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Users(UserId),

Name NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

Description NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,

Date DATETIME2 NOT NULL,

Location NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

MaxParticipants INT NOT NULL,

Status NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Draft' CHECK (Status IN ('Draft', 'Open', 'Closed', 'Cancelled')),

CreatedAt DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

UpdatedAt DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETUTCDATE()

);

\-- Categories Table

CREATE TABLE Categories (

CategoryId INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

EventId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Events(EventId) ON DELETE CASCADE,

Name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

Description NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,

EntryFee DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

StartTime TIME NULL,

MaxCapacity INT NOT NULL,

CONSTRAINT UQ\_Category\_EventName UNIQUE (EventId, Name)

);

\-- Enrolments Table

CREATE TABLE Enrolments (

EnrolmentId INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

ParticipantId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Users(UserId),

CategoryId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Categories(CategoryId),

EnrolmentDate DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

Status NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending' CHECK (Status IN ('Pending', 'Confirmed', 'Cancelled', 'Completed')),

PaymentReference NVARCHAR(100) NULL,

BibNumber INT NULL,

CONSTRAINT UQ\_Enrolment\_ParticipantCategory UNIQUE (ParticipantId, CategoryId)

);

\-- Results Table

CREATE TABLE Results (

ResultId INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

ParticipantId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Users(UserId),

CategoryId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Categories(CategoryId),

EventId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Events(EventId),

FinishTime TIME NULL,

Position INT NULL,

Status NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DNS' CHECK (Status IN ('DNS', 'DNF', 'Finished')),

Notes NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL

);

\-- WeatherForecasts Table

CREATE TABLE WeatherForecasts (

ForecastId INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

EventId INT NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES Events(EventId) ON DELETE CASCADE,

ForecastDate DATE NOT NULL,

TemperatureHigh DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,

TemperatureLow DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,

\[Condition\] NVARCHAR(100) NULL,

WindSpeed DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,

Humidity DECIMAL(5,2) NULL,

LastUpdated DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETUTCDATE()

);
